question: A thermodynamic system is taken through the cycle $abcda$. The work done by the gas along the path $bc$ is :
diagram_alt: Rectangular cycle on a P-V graph: a (100 cm³, 100 kPa), b (400 cm³, 100 kPa), c (400 cm³, 300 kPa), d (100 cm³, 300 kPa)
solution:
Along $bc$, the volume stays at $400\ \text{cm}^3$ while the pressure rises from $100$ kPa to $300$ kPa. It is an isochoric process, so
$$W_{bc} = P\,\Delta V = 0$$
